instagram.selection: Self-contained strong moments from the same sources; at least one when usable material permits

deliverables.captions: Readable verbatim captions; optional on YouTube, included on Reels unless the user requests otherwise

typography.fontFiles: Use a supplied licensed font asset when available; never claim a fallback is Helvetica
typography.legibility: Subtle shadow or restrained backing only when footage requires it

accent.name: Neon pink
accent.usage: Optional funky variation, used sparingly; white remains the default

motion.default: Static typography, clean cuts or a short soft fade

editing.pacing: Tighten dead space without cutting words or flattening the speaker's delivery
editing.storage: Source-adjacent edit folder on external USB or D:; never put new media caches on C:

assets.policy: User-added references begin pending; only explicitly approved assets are reusable style sources

workflow: Every requested video or chronological dump normally produces a YouTube edit plus vertical Reels using this foundation. Inspect the actual footage and speech. Do not infer a good story from date order alone.
